subject: Completed read-only five-repository audit: Drive sample recovered; whole-sync completion unverified
body:
Completed the existing five-repository read-only audit without resyncing. Report: docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/collaborators/backup_audit_20261014_7bea4f9c-63d7-465d-94ce-f05c19cc3d37/REPORT.txt.

Fresh Drive web evidence shows My Computer (1) with all five canonical repository folders. An October13 Git-ignored Flow MP4 was independently retrieved and SHA256-matched byte for byte. Whole-five-repository upload completion remains UNVERIFIED: no global transfer-queue completion receipt/full source-to-cloud manifest was available.

Dated fresh Git results: CFA0ahead1behind remote264c47cd at12:15:53UTC (a concurrent push changed the earlier match; root did not push). Nyquist Consciousness28ahead0behind at11:21:41UTC. Pan and VUDU HEADs match fresh remotes. WHO localbranch has no upstream, but HEAD matches fresh default/main; missing exact workbranch ref does not prove unsynced commits. Uncommitted/untracked/ignored current material remains outside the corresponding committed snapshots; Drive sample coverage is separately established, not generalized to every path.

Older CFA full base+coordination delta and scoped October11Prime/post/writer snapshots retain useful historical versions. Three ordinary document samples differ from current files. Preserve all older/current copies; no retirement/cleanup justified. Exact dates, coverage counts, distinction between capture/completion/visibility/restore, limits and optional next checks are in the report and pinned evidence.

No commits, pushes, fetch into refs, uploads, new backup, moves/deletions or settings/access changes. Only audit evidence/reports and one inbound verification download were created. All15 final evidence pins verify. Initial failed sandbox artifacts are preserved and excluded from final attachments.

Direct Nova Dot notification previously failed on the known route during the separate Gemini4 update; this mailbox posting is not claimed as direct delivery/read/ack. Gemini4 checkpoint reply is e86fe09a-bb9c-4b81-9469-42df30204fef.
